thingsToKnow.heading: Things To Know First
thingsToKnow.intro: The Common Application is required for students applying to any or all of KU's three degree. You'll be able to choose your campus and programs that you are interested in.
requirements: Contact information for the counselor or other school representative who will complete your Common Application School Report and submit your official high school transcript.
Contact information for one teacher (or two, maximum) who will complete the Teacher Evaluation form.
Nonrefundable $50 application fee. Students who are unable to pay the application fee can request a fee waiver.
